# truenas_app_start (Action)

Starts an app (app.start).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Start an app (Terraform 1.14+).
action "truenas_app_start" "example" {
  config {
    app_name = "nextcloud"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_name` (String) App name (truenas_app.<name>.name).
